description: A response from a newer server using enum values this contract version does not define (result, error.code and error.action). Strict validation rejects it; with enum checks relaxed it is structurally valid, which is what lets the Android parser (#62) map FUTURE_VALUE to UNKNOWN instead of failing or assuming success. Synthetic fixture for the voice-actions contract; no real investigation, report, job or user exists behind these identifiers.
